scripts.dev: npm run build -w @consigna/contracts && concurrently -k -n bancos,api,web -c yellow,cyan,magenta "npm run dev -w @consigna/bank-mocks" "npm run dev -w @consigna/api" "npm run dev -w @consigna/web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @consigna/contracts && npm run build -w @consigna/bank-mocks && npm run build -w @consigna/api && npm run build -w @consigna/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w @consigna/contracts && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
scripts.check: npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run build
scripts.format: prettier --write apps packages docs README.md package.json tsconfig.base.json eslint.config.js compose.yaml .github .prettierrc.json
